chapters.label: Live: the 2004 final
chapters.text: The 2004 Futsal World Cup final, in Taipei. Spain play Italy. Kike is Spain’s fixo, the last defender. He scores the first goal, and Spain win two one!

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: Fixos read the game. This is how he does it: he watches the passer, thinks one pass ahead and steps into the gap early. The ball comes, and he steals it and attacks!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Eyes up, step early, win the ball!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: think one pass ahead, so you are already there when it comes!
